opinions.text: Ct. App. N. Y. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 812.] Motions for leave to file briefs as amici curiae by the following were granted: American Psychological Association et al., Center for Constitutional Rights et al., American Civil Liberties Union et al., Committees on Sex and Law et al. of the Association of the Bar of the City of New York, American Association for Personal Privacy et al., Lambda Legal Defense & Education Fund, Inc., and National Association of Business Councils et al.
